title: Engram Runtime paired agent-memory evaluation
research_question: Does Engram improve agent performance generally and with statistically defensible evidence?

excluded_models.gpt-5.3-codex-spark: Unavailable to Codex with this ChatGPT account during preflight; excluded before data collection.

design.pairing_unit: same model, task, repetition, frozen snapshot, shared instructions, non-Engram tools, and budget; the Engram recall directive and tool are the treatment

task_source.role: instrumentation pilot only; not evidence of generalization

tracks.multi_model: Five-model Engram OFF/ON generalization study at common reasoning effort.
tracks.official_memory: LongMemEval-V2 with its fixed-reader methodology for comparison, followed by a separately labeled OpenAI-reader replication.

official_benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench
official_benchmarks.role: external agent execution benchmark; version must be pinned before confirmatory run

official_benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
official_benchmarks.role: external software-engineering benchmark; release must be pinned before confirmatory run

official_benchmarks.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard V4
official_benchmarks.role: external tool-use benchmark; release must be pinned before confirmatory run

primary_endpoint.name: paired_task_completion_difference
primary_endpoint.definition: Engram ON completion minus Engram OFF completion
primary_endpoint.grader: objective benchmark verifier or executable tests

secondary_endpoints: reported input, cached input, uncached input, output, and reasoning tokens
llm_judging_policy: LLM judgments are secondary diagnostics only and cannot override an objective grader.
claim_policy: The pilot estimates feasibility and variance. General claims require the confirmatory sample and official external benchmarks.
